# Content and decorator controls markup reference

Content controls, headers, tabs, scrolling, popups, and decorators.

### TabItem

Receiver: `TabItem`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Content(Element content)` | `Content` | Sets the content element. |
| `Header(Element header)` | `Header` | Sets the header element. |
| `Header(Element header, string text)` |  | Sets the header element and semantic header text. |
| `Header(string text, bool accessKey = true)` | `Header` | Sets the header text. |
| `HeaderText(string value)` | `HeaderText` | Sets the semantic header text used by overflow menus and accessibility surfaces. |
| `IsEnabled(bool value = true)` | `IsEnabled` | Sets whether the tab is enabled. |

### Popup

Receiver: `Popup` and derived types (`where T : Popup`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Content(UIElement value)` | `Content` | Sets the element shown in the popup surface. |
| `OnClosed(EventHandler<PopupClosedEventArgs> handler)` | `event Closed` | Subscribes handler to Closed. Occurs after the popup closes, with why it closed. |
| `OnOpened(EventHandler handler)` | `event Opened` | Subscribes handler to Opened. Occurs after the popup opens. |
| `StaysOpen(bool value = true)` | `StaysOpen` | Sets whether the popup survives an outside press and a focus change, read when it opens; only its owner leaving the visual tree or Close then takes it down. |

### PromptIcon

Receiver: `PromptIcon`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Kind(PromptIconKind value)` | `Kind` | Sets the symbol drawn. |

### RotationDecorator

Receiver: `RotationDecorator`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Child(UIElement value)` | `Child` | Sets the child element. |
| `Rotation(Rotation value)` | `Rotation` | Sets the direction of the 90-degree rotation. |

### Separator

Receiver: `Separator`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Orientation(Orientation value)` | `Orientation` | Sets the direction of the run this rule divides; Horizontal divides a left-to-right run and so draws a vertical rule. |

### ShadowDecorator

Receiver: `ShadowDecorator`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BlurRadius(double value)` | `BlurRadius` | Sets the blur radius of the shadow. |
| `Child(UIElement value)` | `Child` | Sets the child element. |
| `CornerRadius(double value)` | `CornerRadius` | Sets the corner radius of the shadow shape. |
| `OffsetY(double value)` | `OffsetY` | Sets the vertical offset of the shadow. |
| `ShadowColor(Color value)` | `ShadowColor` | Sets the shadow color (including alpha for intensity). |

### TransformDecorator

Receiver: `TransformDecorator`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Child(UIElement value)` | `Child` | Sets the child element. |
| `Mode(TransformMode value)` | `Mode` | Sets whether the transform takes part in layout; the default is Render. |
| `Transform(Matrix3x2 value)` | `Transform` | Sets the transform applied to the child, in DIPs; the default is identity. |
| `TransformOrigin(Point value)` | `TransformOrigin` | Sets the point the transform is applied about in Render mode, as a fraction of this element's size (0..1); the default is the center (0.5, 0.5). |

### Viewbox

Receiver: `Viewbox`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Child(UIElement value)` | `Child` | Sets the child element. |
| `Stretch(Stretch value)` | `Stretch` | Sets how the child is scaled to fill this element; the default is Uniform. |
| `StretchDirection(StretchDirection value)` | `StretchDirection` | Sets whether the scale may enlarge the child, shrink it, or both; the default is Both. |

### Border

Receiver: `Border`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BorderThickness(Thickness thickness)` | `NonUniformBorderThickness` | Sets the per-side border thickness. |
| `Child(UIElement value)` | `Child` | Sets the child element. |
| `ClipToBounds(bool value = true)` | `ClipToBounds` | Sets whether the child is clipped to the border bounds, following the rounded corners when CornerRadius is set. |
| `CornerRadius(CornerRadius cornerRadius)` | `NonUniformCornerRadius` | Sets the per-corner radius. |

### ContentControl

Receiver: `ContentControl` and derived types (`where T : ContentControl`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Content(Element value)` | `Content` | Sets the content element. |

### TabControl

Receiver: `TabControl`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `OnSelectionChanged(Action<object> handler)` | `event SelectionChanged` | Subscribes handler to SelectionChanged. Occurs when the selected tab changes. |
| `SelectedIndex(int value)` | `SelectedIndex` | Sets the selected tab index. |
| `SelectedItem(object value)` | `SelectedItem` | Sets the currently selected item object for selection consistency. |
| `Tab(Element header, Element content)` |  | Adds a tab with element header. |
| `Tab(string header, Element content)` |  | Adds a tab with text header. |
| `TabItems(params TabItem[] tabs)` |  | Sets the tab items. |
| `TabPlacement(TabPlacement value)` | `TabPlacement` | Sets where the tab headers are placed. |

### TransitionContentControl

Receiver: `TransitionContentControl` and derived types (`where T : TransitionContentControl`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Content(Element value)` | `Content` | Sets the content element; changing it plays the configured transition. |
| `OnTransitionCompleted(Action handler)` | `event TransitionCompleted` | Subscribes handler to TransitionCompleted. Raised once a content change has finished playing, including the run out to nothing. |
| `Transition(ContentTransition value)` | `Transition` | Sets the transition applied when content changes. |

### HeaderedContentControl

Receiver: `HeaderedContentControl` and derived types (`where T : HeaderedContentControl`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Header(Element header)` | `Header` | Sets the header element. |
| `Header(string text, bool accessKey = true)` | `Header` | Sets the header text. |
| `HeaderSpacing(double value)` | `HeaderSpacing` | Sets the spacing between header and content. |

### ScrollBar

Receiver: `ScrollBar`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Orientation(Orientation value)` | `Orientation` | Sets the scroll direction (vertical or horizontal). |
| `ViewportSize(double value)` | `ViewportSize` | Sets the viewport size in DIPs, which sizes the thumb relative to the scroll range. |

### ScrollViewer

Receiver: `ScrollViewer`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `AutoHideScrollBars(bool value = true)` | `AutoHideScrollBars` | Sets whether scrollbars overlay the content, reserving no width, and stay hidden until a scroll or a pointer over the bar region reveals them; the default is false. |
| `AutoHorizontalScroll()` |  | Sets HorizontalScroll to Auto. |
| `AutoVerticalScroll()` |  | Sets VerticalScroll to Auto. |
| `HorizontalScroll(ScrollMode value)` | `HorizontalScroll` | Sets the horizontal scroll mode. |
| `NoHorizontalScroll()` |  | Sets HorizontalScroll to Disabled. |
| `NoVerticalScroll()` |  | Sets VerticalScroll to Disabled. |
| `OnScrollChanged(Action handler)` | `event ScrollChanged` | Subscribes handler to ScrollChanged. Raised when scroll metrics or offsets change. |
| `Scroll(ScrollMode vertical, ScrollMode horizontal)` | `VerticalScroll`, `HorizontalScroll` | Sets VerticalScroll and HorizontalScroll. |
| `ShowHorizontalScroll()` |  | Sets HorizontalScroll to Visible. |
| `ShowVerticalScroll()` |  | Sets VerticalScroll to Visible. |
| `VerticalScroll(ScrollMode value)` | `VerticalScroll` | Sets the vertical scroll mode. |

| Method | Sets | Summary |
